title: macOS voice: physical speaker-to-microphone calibration
scope: Two actual Apple playback requests with timestamped microphone pickup and matching rendered-audio energy envelopes; collector calibration only.
summary: First-after-preparation pickup 1247 ms; next phrase 299 ms. Both correlated with actual rendered audio. One warm sample, no ASR load, no model ranking or default choice.

environment.workload: Apple-only physical calibration; no ASR load; not model-ranking or default evidence. Built-in microphone and speakers; current hardware volume retained.
environment.cold_warm: One first request after preparation; one varied subsequent phrase. OS service caches not hardware-cold.
environment.audio_route: Built-in microphone and speakers; source volume0.75. Existing hardware volume retained; not sampled at the exact trial boundaries.
environment.power_thermal: Not continuously sampled; no claim of a controlled thermal/power state.

provenance.command: Tools/tts_compare.py --engines apple --trials1 --speaker-output; complete command/source context in retained report
provenance.grader: Native captured host timestamps; >=0.75 rendered/microphone envelope correlation; quiet baseline, threshold and route/drop gates. No microphone recording saved.

metrics.name: First-after-preparation microphone pickup
metrics.boundary: Text request → correlated microphone pickup, above frozen detector threshold.

metrics.name: First-after-preparation non-silent render
metrics.boundary: Text request → first post-gain rendered sample >=0.001 amplitude, native host timestamp.

metrics.name: First-after-preparation estimated presentation
metrics.boundary: Text request → render timestamp + queried maximum downstream presentation-latency estimate; not observed acoustic output.

metrics.name: Subsequent phrase microphone pickup
metrics.boundary: Text request → correlated microphone pickup, above frozen detector threshold.

metrics.name: Subsequent phrase non-silent render
metrics.boundary: Text request → first post-gain rendered sample >=0.001 amplitude, native host timestamp.

metrics.name: Subsequent phrase estimated presentation
metrics.boundary: Text request → render timestamp + queried maximum downstream presentation-latency estimate; not observed acoustic output.

limitations: Calibration only: n1 per phase; no median/tail or fastest-default conclusion.
Microphone onset uses10ms energy windows and >max(0.001RMS,4x room baseline); it is not human perceptual onset.
Native render and maximum presentation-latency estimate are separate from actual microphone observation.
No concurrent ASR/EOU/normal voice conversation, no route matrix or double-talk qualification.

publication.reviewed_by: Codex TTS: public fields reviewed for privacy and calibration-only scope
